# U.S. Copyright Office

> > Official U.S. government portal for copyright registration, public records search, licensing, and claims resolution administered by the Library of Congress.

The U.S. Copyright Office administers the nation's copyright laws under Title 17 of the U.S. Code, providing services including the Electronic Copyright Office (eCO) Registration System, the Copyright Public Records System (CPRS), the Copyright Claims Board (CCB), and licensing recordation. Located in the James Madison Memorial Building in Washington, DC, the Office maintains historical records dating back to 1870 and processes various registration types including Standard Applications, Group Registration of Two-Dimensional Artwork (GR2D), and Group of Unpublished Works.

## Key Topics

- Copyright registration and eCO system
- Copyright Public Records System (CPRS)
- Copyright Claims Board (CCB)
- Title 17 of the U.S. Code
- Electronic Copyright Office (eCO) Registration System
- Group registration options (GR2D, unpublished works)
- Licensing and recordation services
- Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests
- Library of Congress partnership
- James Madison Memorial Building
- Intellectual property law
- Standard Application process
- Historical copyright records (1870-1977)
- Government copyright services

## Copyright Registration

- [U.S. Copyright Office | U.S. Copyright Office](http://copyright.gov): Homepage for U.S. Copyright Office with CPRS and CCB access
- [Register Your Work: Registration Portal | U.S. Copyright Office](https://www.copyright.gov/registration/): Main registration portal for eCO system and copyright applications
- [U.S. Copyright Office - eCO Registration System](https://upload.eco.copyright.gov/): eCO Registration System login portal for copyright submissions

## Public Records and Research

- [Virtual Card Catalog | U.S. Copyright Office](https://vcc.copyright.gov/): Virtual Card Catalog for historical copyright records 1870-1977

## Licensing and Support

- [U.S. Copyright Office - Licensing Section](https://licensing.copyright.gov/lds/contactUs.jsp): Contact page for Licensing Section inquiries and FOIA requests
